glosses: truck; lorry (vehicle designed to carry or haul heavy cargo)
truckload; boatload (a great quantity of something)

examples.text: A rua é muito estreita para camiões.
examples.en: The street is too narrow for trucks.

examples.text: Tens a certeza de que podes conduzir um camião desse tamanho?
examples.en: Are you sure you can drive a truck this big?
